label: political body has a leader
definition: Country, political body or legislature X has or had person Y as a political leader.
scope_notes: Includes: national president/ruler/head of government; named parliamentary majority/minority leader or whip; historical leadership. Excludes: corporate/team leadership; ordinary membership/meeting; party control instead of an individual leader; person-to-body forward direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unspecified minister without evidence of head-of-government or leadership scope; truncated body or unnamed officeholder. Harmonizes the later minister-inclusive samples to the original full-census scope. An unspecified minister alone is A, not automatically S.

predicate_provenance.status: Canonical prior-scope assignment; reviewer must verify full dictionary before final census judgment
